subject: [PATCH v4 1/8] mm/page_alloc: reset can_retry_reserves when the slowpath restarts

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch resets the can_retry_reserves flag when the slowpath restarts after a cpuset update or zonelist rebuild, allowing GFP_NOWAIT | __GFP_MEMALLOC callers to retry reserves again. This change fixes an issue where these callers failed without trying reserves again due to the flag being set and never reset. The patch only resets can_retry_reserves in cases where the slowpath restarts, ensuring that the retry still runs at most once per change.
